descriere: Sets the input terminal for input "Emergency Stop" (operating mode "function interface"). The behavior of this input signal is set in p10021.
Sets the signal sources for F-DO 0. The 6 signal sources in p10042[0...5] are AND'ed and the result is output at F-DO 0.
Sets the signal sources for F-DO 1. The 6 signal sources in p10043[0...5] are AND'ed and the result is output at F-DO 1.
Sets the signal sources for F-DO 2. The 6 signal sources in p10044[0...5] are AND'ed and the result is output at F-DO 2.
Sets the signal sources for F-DO 3. The 6 signal sources in p10045[0...5] are AND'ed and the result is output at F-DO 3.
Displays the smoothed actual value of the motor speed.
Displays the smoothed output voltage of the power unit.
Displays the smoothed field-generating actual current.

Displays the power unit overload determined using the I2t calculation. A current reference value is defined for the I2t monitoring of the power unit. It represents the current that can be conducted by the power unit without any influence of the switching losses (e.g. the continuously permissible current of the capacitors, inductances, busbars, etc.). If the I2t reference current of the power unit is not exceeded, then an overload (0 %) is not displayed. In the other case, the degree of thermal overload is calculated, whereby 100% results in a trip.
Displays the smoothed actual power factor.

descriere_scurta: Motor data ident. routine and speed controller optimization
descriere: Displays the actual status for the motor data identification (standstill measurement) and the speed/velocity control- ler optimization (rotating measurement).

descriere_scurta: Speed setpoint before the setpoint filter
descriere: Displays the actual speed setpoint at the input of the speed controller or V/f characteristic (after the interpolator).
Displays the actual system deviation of the speed controller.
Displays the maximum modulation depth.
Displays the torque/force generating current setpoint.
Displays the torque utilization as a percentage. The torque utilization is obtained from the required smoothed torque referred to the torque limit.
Displays the "active/inactive" state of a drive object.
Displays the actual maximum output current of the power unit taking into account derating factors.

descriere_scurta: Power unit alarm threshold model temperature
descriere: Temperature alarm threshold for the difference from the chip and heat sink temperature in the thermal model.

descriere_scurta: Central measuring probe, status word display
descriere: Displays the status word for the function "central measuring probe evaluation".

descriere_scurta: CU digital inputs, terminal actual value
descriere: Displays the actual value at the digital inputs. This means that the actual input signal can be checked at terminal DI x or DI/DO x prior to switching from the simu- lation mode (p0795.x = 1) to terminal mode (p0795.x = 0). The input signal at terminal DI x is displayed in bit x of r0721.
Displays the selected and effective fixed speed setpoint. This setpoint is the output value for the fixed speed setpoints and must be appropriately interconnected (e.g. with the main setpoint).
Displays the effective positive speed limit.
Displays the speed/velocity setpoint after the changeover and limiting the direction.
Displays the acceleration of the ramp-function generator.
Displays the total resulting voltage boost in volt (p1310 + p1311 + p1312).
Displays the actual compensated slip [%] referred to r0330 (rated motor slip).

descriere_scurta: Speed controller reference model speed setpoint output
descriere: Displays the speed setpoint at the output of the reference model.

descriere_scurta: Speed actual value at actual value input speed controller
descriere: Displays the speed actual value at the speed controller's free-wiring actual value input p1440.
Displays the output signal of the droop calculation. The droop feedback result is subtracted from the speed setpoint when activated (p1492).
Displays the upper torque limit of all torque limits without offset.
Displays the load angle of the current model.

descriere_scurta: Current model, magnetizing current, d axis
descriere: Displays the magnetizing current of the current model in the d-axis.
Displays the actual output of the Isd current controller (flux-generating current, PI controller). The value contains the proportional and integral components of the PI controller.
Displays the actual output of the quadrature channel de-coupling for the d axis.
Displays the absolute value of the flux of the motor model.

descriere_scurta: Motor model Lh adaptation power-on frequency
descriere: Displays the power-on stator frequency/ primary section frequency for the Lh adaptation for the induction motor (ASM).
Status of the actual value correction
Status display of test pulse evaluation. Short-circuit test: Bit0: No faults detected during short-circuit test. Bit1: Phase short-circuit detected.

Displays the saturation characteristic of the pole position identification routine. The values for the characteristic of the last saturation-based pole position identification routine are output every 1 ms in order to record signals (e.g. trace).
Status display for the PROFIBUS interface.
Displays the code of the last alarm that occurred.

descriere_scurta: Technology controller motorized potentiometer setpoint memory /
descriere: Displays the setpoint memory for the motorized potentiometer of the technology controller. For p2230.0 = 1, the last setpoint that was saved is entered after ON.
Displays the scaled actual value signal of the technology controller.
Displays the output signal of the technology controller.

Connector output of the reference quantity for currents p2002. All currents specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity in this parame- ter corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex or 4000 0000 hex. This parameter has the unit Arms.

Connector output of the reference quantity for angles p2005. All angles specified as relative value are referred to this reference quantity. The reference quantity in this parameter corresponds to 100% or 4000 hex or 4000 0000 hex. This parameter has the unit degree.
Displays the torque of the friction characteristic dependent on the speed.
Displays the BICO interconnections that have been parameterized in the complete (overall) topology. The counter is incremented by one for each modified BICO interconnection.
Displays the actual status of the measuring function.

descriere_scurta: Par_circuit No. of active power units
descriere: Displays the active power units for a parallel circuit configuration.

descriere_scurta: Par_circuit max. deviation currents phase W
descriere: Displays the maximum absolute deviation of the measured current actual values of phase W from the average value as peak value. The deviation of the individual currents from the average value is displayed in r7022.
Displays the progress when updating the firmware of the DRIVE-CLiQ components.

Displays the signals of the wordwise received data (process signal). This signal value is interconnected and transferred via CI: p8505.

descriere: Displays the number of BICO interconnections to the signal sink being searched for. The signal source to be searched is set in p9484 (BICO-coded). The search result is contained in r9482[0...59] and r9483[0...59] and is specified by the count (r9485) and the first index (r9486).

descriere_scurta: SI Motion crosswise comparison clock cycle
descriere: Displays the crosswise comparison clock cycle. The value indicates the clock cycle time with which each individual DCC value is compared between the two moni- toring channels.
Displays the clock cycle time for the Safety Integrated Basic Functions on the Control Unit.

descriere_scurta: SI actual checksum SI parameters (Control Unit)
descriere: Displays the checksum over the checked Safety Integrated parameters on the Control Unit (actual checksum).

descriere_scurta: Sampling time with largest total utilization
descriere: Displays the sampling time with the largest total utilization.
Displays the control word for the Basic Operator Panel (BOP).

descriere: Displays the effective Motor Data Set (MDS) and the effective Encoder Data Sets (EDS). Index: [0] = Motor Data Set MDS effective [1] = Encoder 1 Encoder Data Set EDS effective [2] = Encoder 2 Encoder Data Set EDS effective [3] = Encoder 3 Encoder Data Set EDS effective
